title: clematis multiflora
intro: Clematis multiflora, commonly known as sweet autumn clematis, is a flowering plant native to Asia and is a member of the Ranunculaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing fever, relieving pain, and promoting digestion. The therapeutic actions of clematis multiflora include its antipyretic, analgesic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The bioactive constituents of clematis multiflora have been shown to have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, contributing to its potential therapeutic effects.
